**Download one:** `Kami-oke-Setup-2.2.1.exe` installs with shortcuts; `Kami-oke-2.2.1-Portable.exe` runs without installing. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed). Your songs, singers and settings carry over.

### 2.2.1
- **Fixed: YouTube videos that block embedding played sound but showed a black screen.** The picture (and the lyrics burned into it) now fills the stage. These are the videos Kami-oke plays on YouTube's own page, including any YouTube song you've changed the key of.
- If YouTube shows a cookie or sign-in prompt on that page, it now appears so you can click through it, instead of being hidden.

See the [2.2.0 notes](https://github.com/terpenesalad/karaoke/releases/tag/v2.2.0) for YouTube key change and remembered singers.
